title: Machine-learned potentials resolve a disorder trade-off in lithium cathode transport
summary: Using actively fine-tuned machine-learning interatomic potentials with experimental validation, the authors report that cation disorder improves lithium-path connectivity but broadens site energies, suppressing diffusion in disordered-rocksalt cathodes. They develop an energy-adjusted percolation descriptor and a Li–Mn–Ti–O design map. This is a composition-specific transport result; the review does not assign individual capacity figures to modeled or measured material states.
organization: Tsinghua University; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; Binzhou Institute of Technology

evidence.tested: Publisher abstract describes atomistic analysis combined with experimental validation within the discovery study.
evidence.unknown: Review scope was the publisher abstract and metadata; full experimental details and capacity attribution were not assessed. Article-in-press text may change.
evidence.ai_role: Learned atomistic potentials enabled analysis of lithium connectivity and site-energy distributions.
